# Terminal Machine dogfood replay — Semantic Source Control v0.2.2

Input evidence:
  terminal_ssc_dogfood_v0.1.zip
  produced from Terminal Machine v0.19 -> v0.20 dogfood
  runtime ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 debug

The supplied dogfood pack reported two v0.2 defects:

1. ::constant and ::attribute were retained as source bytes but invisible to the
   semantic comparison engine.
2. contentHash() launched sha256sum separately for entity hashes, causing full-tree
   method-heavy analysis to scale badly.

Exact reproducer replay
-----------------------

Input v1:
  ::constant MODE "A"
  ::attribute value get

Input v2:
  ::constant MODE "B"
  ::attribute value set

v0.2 result in the supplied report:
  changedComponents=0
  semanticDeltas=0
  impactFindings=0

v0.2.2 result:
  CONSTANT_VALUE_CHANGED Surface.Surface.MODE#CONSTANT
  ATTRIBUTE_ACCESS_CHANGED Surface.Surface.value#ATTRIBUTE

This is intentionally not represented as synthetic ::method changes. Constants and
attributes are independent OO source surfaces.

Accessor body semantics
-----------------------

ooRexx allows explicit ::attribute ... get and ::attribute ... set directives to own
method bodies. v0.2.2 aggregates paired accessors into one conceptual attribute while
retaining separate getter/setter implementation hashes. A getter body-only mutation is
therefore reported as ATTRIBUTE_GETTER_IMPLEMENTATION_CHANGED [VERIFY].

Consumer semantics
------------------

  object~value              -> getter message `value`
  object~value = expression -> setter message `value=` when assignment is the leading send
  .Class~CONSTANT           -> class-literal constant consumer evidence

Dynamic receiver evidence remains conservative rather than being claimed as an exact
resolved dependency.

Hash scaling
------------

Tree analysis now performs a side-effect-free warm-up pass, batches unique SHA-256
payloads, invokes sha256sum once for the generated 1,200-method regression, and then
runs authoritative semantic analysis from the in-memory digest cache.

Observed on the r13196 debug host:
  v0.2.2: ~6 seconds, one sha256sum invocation
  v0.2.1 same synthetic corpus: ~14 seconds

Repository identity remains SHA-256. Isolated contentHash calls retain a safe fallback.

Scope note
----------

The Terminal dogfood bundle carries the report and exact constant/attribute reproducer,
not the complete 102-file Terminal v0.19 source release. Therefore full-tree Terminal
performance is deliberately not claimed by this package; that corpus remains an
external certification test for the Terminal owner.
